items.title: OpenClaw 2.0 Just Made AI Coding MULTIPLAYER 🤯 #Shorts
items.description:
OpenClaw 2.0 is here: the open source AI agent harness shipped its biggest release ever, with 933 contributors and over 16,000 pull requests merged. The headline feature is shared cloud sessions, so an entire team can work inside one AI agent instead of one harness per developer. Creator Peter Steinberger says local harnesses feel like relics of the past now, but reviewers note sandboxing and command approvals ship off by default, so teams should lock those down before rolling it out.

In this Short:
• OpenClaw 2.0 (release 2026.8.1), the project's biggest update yet
• 933 contributors, 16,000
items.summary: OpenClaw 2.0 发布了项目迄今为止最大的更新版本（2026.8.1），引入共享云会话功能，允许整个团队在一个 AI 代理中协同工作，而非每个开发者单独使用一个本地代理。该版本由 933 位贡献者参与，已合并超过 16,000 次拉取请求。虽然开发者认为本地代理已显得陈旧，但审查者指出，沙箱化和命令批准功能默认关闭，团队在推广前应确保这些安全设置已启用。
